source.regulation: 19 TAC §111.30(c), Grade 7 Middle School Advanced Mathematics

note: Editorial abstracts, not official verbatim expectations; preserve parent-stem, subpart, and qualifier distinctions. Do not infer canonical equivalence, teacher/generator implementation, assessments, or mastery.

rows.scope: Describe subset relationships among real-number sets using visual representations.
Approximate irrational values, including π and square roots of numbers below 225, and place rational estimates on a number line.
Convert standard decimal and scientific notation in both directions.
Order real numbers in mathematical and applied contexts.
Fluently add, subtract, multiply and divide rational numbers.
Use all four rational-number operations to solve problems.
Solve ratio, rate and percent problems, including multistep percent increases/decreases and financial contexts.
Calculate and compare simple- and compound-interest earnings.
Analyze and compare sales, rebates, coupons and related monetary incentives.
Compare how borrowing interest rate and loan length affect the overall cost of credit.
Calculate repayment costs of credit cards and easy-access loans for varying rates and terms using an online calculator.
Explain long-term growth when small amounts are invested regularly, including college and retirement savings.
Estimate two- and four-year college costs, including a family contribution; devise periodic savings toward at least first-year attendance.
Relate π to the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.
Generalize similarity attributes, including ratios within and between similar shapes.
Solve similar-figure and scale-drawing problems in mathematics and real-world contexts.
Compare shape attributes with those of coordinate-plane dilations.
Explain origin-centered coordinate-plane dilations of two-dimensional figures algebraically for a given positive rational scale factor.
